rationale: The buyer is specific and real — Salesforce/AgentForce developers at enterprise companies — and the pain of opaque MCP schema errors blocking AI agent deployments is genuine and recurring. However, the signal is a single forum post from a very nascent ecosystem (AgentForce + MCP is 2025–2026 vintage), so market size and buyer volume are unproven. The total of 5.4 falls just below the validate threshold of 5.5, and operational_autonomy (6) is at the floor for a validate push — delivery would require ongoing schema database maintenance and Salesforce ecosystem tracking that is meaningful but not fully hands-off. Willingness to pay is possible but unproven at the product level.
solution_plan: The idea is a validator/linter that checks MCP tool schema definitions for AgentForce compatibility before deployment, delivered as a web tool: paste your MCP schema JSON, get a compatibility report with fix suggestions. The factory builds this as a Claude prompt that understands AgentForce schema rules + a simple web intake form + a Stripe payment link for a one-time report or a $29/mo subscription. Outreach would target Salesforce developer communities (Trailblazer Community, LinkedIn Salesforce developer groups) with a free-tier hook — operator approves each outreach batch before it sends. Delivery is fully automated (schema in → Claude analysis out → PDF/HTML report). Support is Claude-handled for common questions; operator reviews edge cases. The main recurring human task is keeping the schema rules updated as Salesforce releases AgentForce changes — roughly monthly review. This is buildable but the market is very early-stage; validate before committing build resources.
notes: Total 5.4 is 0.1 below min_total_to_validate (5.5) — borderline drop vs validate. The opportunity is worth monitoring as the AgentForce + MCP ecosystem matures. If signal_strength increases (more posts, community threads, developer complaints), re-score in 30 days. Operational_autonomy (6) and buildability_with_ai (6) meet build gate minimums, but the total doesn't yet support even validate stage by the model.
